title: Anabignes
summary: Raleigh names Anabignes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Anabignes, a sonne of Darius, named last of the fiue sonnes left at his death. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter V, §. VIII, sig. 410a
